description: Formal Enterprise Domain Ontology governing Ubiquitous Language concepts, code artifacts, business rules (BR-*), and architecture decision records (ADR-*) across Telecom NMS/OSS and Financial Advisory domains.

CodeArtifact.description: Executable source code constructs (Classes, Methods, Stored Procedures).

BusinessRule.description: Deterministic operational or compliance constraints extracted from legacy code and specs.

ArchitectureDecision.description: Formal Architecture Decision Records (ADR-*) governing To-Be system design.

DomainConcept.description: Canonical Ubiquitous Language concepts with cross-lingual (KO/EN) and symbol mappings.

ENFORCES_RULE.description: Source code artifact directly implements or enforces a business rule.

GOVERNS_RULE.description: ADR establishes the architectural rationale or constraint governing a business rule.

GOVERNS_COMPONENT.description: ADR governs the structural design of a code component.

DEPENDS_ON_SYMBOL.description: Code artifact invokes or references another code symbol.

REQUIRES_CONCEPT.description: Business rule depends on a canonical Ubiquitous Language domain concept.
